authority: existing CORE_DB Mongo application state; no new runtime service, provider or learning owner
routes: Authenticated /api/game-learning catalogue, projects, source ingestion, editor revisions, simulation sessions, training/generation jobs, cancellation and project export

persistence.projects: version-fenced project head with immutable file revisions and prepared source membership
persistence.sources: immutable observed bytes in bounded Mongo chunks, committed source manifest, exact digest/provenance/rights and authority epoch
persistence.sessions: Actual adapter snapshots with same-row unfenced/version CAS; new-session membership requires exact project input epoch/version. Editor/source mutations advance the head epoch and fence existing sessions before changing authority. Orphan publication retries repair exact membership only; stale/fenced receipt replay is denied.
persistence.jobs: durable queued/running/terminal records; exact immutable input revision, worker UUID fence and same-document full policy checkpoint plus latest episode
persistence.restart: expired running workers become interrupted; committed checkpoints remain resumable under a new worker fence; queued jobs remain persisted and may be scheduled on owner reads
persistence.policies: full measured local policy snapshot with source/environment and episode lineage; candidate-only authority
persistence.dragon: Existing Dragon Academy principal and configured SQLite owner only; exact current reviewed ledger record read through DragonGameKnowledgeAdapter. Review writer guard spans Mongo checkpoint/terminal publication; current rights are rechecked before policy reuse/export.
persistence.incremental_learning: Completed parent policy is pinned by exact snapshot digest and current sources/environment; a new candidate preserves learned Q values and inherited evidence, uses a fresh job budget, and measures paired held-out returns against the actual parent.
persistence.audit: Episode audit projection is prepared before the single authoritative full snapshot-plus-trace job update. Prepared audit/source/job records confer no membership or policy authority.
persistence.live_play: Existing scoped game-learning plays/recordings with rotating controller epochs and tokens, durable source/input/worker fences, snapshot resume and actual TTL frame projections. See ai_game_play.json.
persistence.parallel_learning: Native one-to-eight process actors use a persisted frozen batch and acknowledged checkpoint prefix; each pending/committed batch-state update shares the authoritative full snapshot/trace job document. Interactive and actor capacity are separately reserved.
persistence.media: Existing upload authority materializes large content through scoped immutable manifests; source registration pins exact content digest/rights/epoch and defaults to the admitted content. Legacy cartridges above2MiB use private hash-bound descriptors.
persistence.policy_default: The admission-observed default pointer is frozen with each new training job. A passing gate may replace only that exact comparator pointer under unchanged project version/input epoch. Seeded-random comparison only selects a default when no default existed. Rejected candidates remain issued and explicitly selectable; old historical rows are not rewritten.

rules: authenticated tenant and owner scope precedes every payload read or mutation
unknown/unowned Dragon references and missing rights consent fail explicitly
uploaded ROM bytes never execute through a reference simulation; only an explicitly declared compatible ROM adapter may consume the exact owned source
source ingestion and generated project bytes are bounded, immutable and digest-bound; callers cannot provide host paths
editor/source mutations fence existing jobs before changing the input revision
cancellation and stale worker/input fences prevent checkpoint/result publication; a process restart never turns unfinished work into success
policy progress, rewards, frames and results come from executed registered adapters and actual learner updates
source-derived knowledge is distinct from game binary compatibility and does not authorize copying uploaded assets into generated games
Stored full source bundles are canonical JSON and their complete digest/provenance are verified before feature or model use.
Simulation actions and frames are actual adapter observations, including generated-grid controllers and the isolated canonical Thumby runtime.
A worker cancellation waits for its physical thread to quiesce before releasing its process/global capacity; Dragon publication guards drain the actual coroutine before release.
Native metadata probes, one-shot sessions, evaluation, generation policy probes and retained trainer environments close their supervised environments on success and failure.
verification: User-directed source implementation with no automated test creation or execution. Static formatting/lint checks do not establish simulation, training or hardware compatibility.
limitations: No automated tests or execution checks were run at user direction.
The workspace uses existing Mongo write acknowledgements and driver timeouts; Mongo/Dragon are distinct stores and no distributed transaction or arbitrary database-writer resistance is claimed.
The 300-second cooperative computation deadline drains bounded in-flight storage/adapter work before reporting terminal state.
Revocation denies further source/policy reuse and removes stored uploaded byte chunks; it does not claim numerical unlearning or deletion of downloaded exports.
Local policy learning uses real bounded tabular Q updates and paired actual environment evaluation; this is not neural training or verified native hardware compatibility.

simulation_execution_extension.authority: existing scoped game_learning_simulation_receipts and game_learning_sessions in CORE_DB
simulation_execution_extension.dispatch: A durable same-key reservation precedes native execution. A reserved or failed operation without a prepared result never authorizes automatic re-execution.
simulation_execution_extension.recovery: The exact bounded prepared session and result can finish publication after interruption without another adapter execution. Session membership, current source rights, input epoch and session version remain fenced.
simulation_execution_extension.physical_cleanup: A raw executor Future is shielded and drained through repeated request cancellation before returning. Every environment closes in finally.
simulation_execution_extension.deadline_scope: Cooperative whole-operation deadline with bounded adapter-call cleanup; timeout does not claim the process was stopped before physical cleanup.
simulation_execution_extension.unresolved_dispatch: Explicit simulation_dispatch_pending or simulation_dispatch_failed; use a new request only as a new authorized operation, never as an exact replay.

profiles.cpu: Current observed CPU/memory partition preserving interactive credits.
profiles.cpu_throughput: Only offered when borrowing idle existing interactive credits increases allowed actors; immutable request selects this mode explicitly.

training_resource_profiles.claims: Both profiles expose server-owned training_credit_ids. Existing actor/play Mongo credit rows are claimed atomically with token/job/lease; no new actor ID or extra capacity. An active human play blocks that same credit until physical quiescence.
training_resource_profiles.limits: Same observed effective CPU count,2GiB per native-compatible instance plus application reserve, global8-actor ceiling; zero capacity remains unavailable.
training_resource_profiles.compatibility: Old requests/jobs default cpu. No policy snapshot identity, numerical counter, source/teacher authority or pending actor batch is rewritten.
